bootstrap.purpose: Post-run uncertainty analysis requested after point estimates were known; not part of the original selection protocol.
bootstrap.block: Supplied target date under recovered fixed UTC+03; resample all149 date blocks with replacement, using identical blocks for both methods.
bootstrap.partial_day: Retain the initial15-hour block. Observed estimate uses all3567hours; resampled hour counts may vary when this shorter block is drawn.
bootstrap.interval: Two-sided95% percentile interval, linear interpolation of ordered bootstrap differences.
bootstrap.direction: NWP minus persistence; positive classification differences and negative errors favour NWP.
